entities.name: Parsman VI of Iberia
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: P'arsman VI, of the Chosroid Dynasty, became the king (mepe) of Iberia in 561. The length of his reign is unknown. The royal power was largely nominal at that time as the Sassanid Empire dominated Iberia.
